findings: The authored component and formation claims still use the retired, scan-disconfirmed 昪 reading: in formation, “assigns the sound role to 臱”; the 臱 component and phonetic relationship treat it as the book’s main sound unit; and 力 is said to replace 臱 in 邊. The inspected scan prints 臱 in the main clause and replacement passage, but the cited evidence establishes only what 字源 prints, not that this unit is historically identical to 臱 in other analyses or that it is a sound component. Cite X-d40625b65a9c8e960c5e for the transcription, keep the book’s attributed proposal distinct from competing referents, and do not present the transcription as independent confirmation of the phonetic analysis.
